```{r libs}
library(survival); library(splines); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(knitr)

PROJ <- "/home/rstudio/project"
if (!dir.exists(PROJ)) PROJ <- normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."))
for (f in c("main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_input_perturbation_phase1.R",
            "main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_input_perturbation_phase3.R",
            "main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_bounds_comparison.R",
            "main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/survival_stacking.R",
            "main/03_simulation/R/data_split.R",
            "main/03_simulation/R/simulation_engine.R",
            "main/04_evaluation/R/nguyen2017_outpert.R")) source(file.path(PROJ, f))

DATASET      <- "flchain"
B_RUN        <- 1000L
LAMBDA_GRID  <- c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000)
NG_BASE_SEED <- 3100000L
Q_PAPER      <- 200L

flchain <- read.csv(file.path(PROJ, "data/01_prepared/flchain_prepared.csv"))
stopifnot(nrow(flchain) == 6524L, !anyNA(flchain))

SPECS <- list(
  list(name = "formal_q200",   type = "formal",
       bounds = FIXED_BOUNDS_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], t_max = T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = Q_PAPER),
  list(name = "datadriven_K13", type = "datadriven",
       K = K_VALUES[[DATASET]], standardize = FALSE),
  list(name = "datadriven_q200", type = "datadriven", K = NA_integer_, standardize = FALSE,
       fixed_time = list(t_max = T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = Q_PAPER)),
  list(name = "formal_K13",   type = "formal",
       bounds = FIXED_BOUNDS_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], t_max = T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = K_VALUES[[DATASET]])
)
SPEC_NAMES <- vapply(SPECS, `[[`, character(1), "name")
stopifnot(identical(SPEC_NAMES, c("formal_q200", "datadriven_K13", "datadriven_q200", "formal_K13")))
stopifnot(identical(SPECS[[4]]$q, K_VALUES[[DATASET]]), K_VALUES[[DATASET]] == 13L)
```

```{r independence-table}
bt <- FIXED_BOUNDS_NGUYEN[[DATASET]]
obs <- flchain %>% transmute(age, sexM = as.integer(sex == "M"), sample.yr,
                             kappa, lambda, creatinine, mgus)
ind <- data.frame(
  変数 = names(bt),
  固定境界 = vapply(bt, function(b) sprintf("[%g, %g]", b[1], b[2]), character(1)),
  観測範囲 = vapply(names(bt), function(v)
    sprintf("[%g, %g]", min(obs[[v]]), max(obs[[v]])), character(1)),
  階層と根拠 = vapply(names(bt), function(v) {
    src_v <- if (identical(v, "sexM")) "sex" else v
    r <- FIXED_BOUNDS_SOURCES[FIXED_BOUNDS_SOURCES$dataset == DATASET &
                              FIXED_BOUNDS_SOURCES$variable == src_v, ]
    if (nrow(r) == 1L) sprintf("Tier %s: %s", r$tier, r$rule)
    else "Tier 0: 符号化規約の定義域（ダミー変数 {0, 1}。本標本に依存しない）"
  }, character(1)),
  row.names = NULL)
kable(ind, caption = paste("固定境界とその根拠（根拠は規約の正本 FIXED_BOUNDS_SOURCES から生成。",
                           "）"))

cat(sprintf("固定の観察期間上限: %.2f 日（ベースライン取得開始 1995-03-13 → 追跡打ち切り 2009-06-30。規約 Tier 6）。観測最大 %.0f 日\n",
            T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], max(flchain$time)))
cat(sprintf("区間数 q = %d（既報 §6.1）、境界は [0,1] の等幅分割\n", Q_PAPER))
cat(sprintf("正則化パラメータ Λ = %g（既報 Table 2 が FL について報告した最良値）\n", 0.1))

clip_by_var <- vapply(names(bt), function(v) {
  ctr <- (bt[[v]][1] + bt[[v]][2]) / 2; half <- (bt[[v]][2] - bt[[v]][1]) / 2
  mean(abs((obs[[v]] - ctr) / half) > 1)
}, numeric(1))
kable(data.frame(変数 = names(bt), クリップ発生率 = sprintf("%.4f%%", 100 * clip_by_var),
                 row.names = NULL),
      caption = "変数別のクリップ発生率（規約の手続き (2) の開示。境界の変更は行わない）")

.sp <- stratified_train_test_split(flchain, 0.3, SPLIT_BASE_SEED + 1L)
.tr <- set_reference_levels(.sp$train, DATASET)
.te <- align_factor_levels(.tr, .sp$test, DATASET)
.tr2 <- .tr; .tr2[1, c("age", "kappa", "lambda", "creatinine")] <- c(101, 999, 999, 99)
.tr2$time[1] <- 99999; .tr2$status[1] <- 1L
.d1 <- build_nguyen_design_formal(.tr, .te, COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]], bt,
                                  T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = Q_PAPER)
.d2 <- build_nguyen_design_formal(.tr2, .te, COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]], bt,
                                  T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = Q_PAPER)
stopifnot(identical(.d1$t_s, .d2$t_s), identical(.d1$scale_unit, .d2$scale_unit),
          identical(.d1$sd_vec, .d2$sd_vec), identical(.d1$X_test_cov, .d2$X_test_cov))
cat("データ非依存性 OK: 1 レコードを置き換えても t_s / scale_unit / 半幅 / test 変換行列が不変\n")
```

```{r design-check-q200}
.sp <- stratified_train_test_split(flchain, 0.3, SPLIT_BASE_SEED + 1L)
.tr <- set_reference_levels(.sp$train, DATASET)
.te <- align_factor_levels(.tr, .sp$test, DATASET)
.d_formal <- build_nguyen_design_formal(.tr, .te, COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]], bt,
                                        T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = Q_PAPER)
.d_k13    <- build_nguyen_design_traintest(.tr, .te, K_VALUES[[DATASET]], COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]],
                                           standardize = FALSE)
.d_q200   <- build_nguyen_design_traintest(.tr, .te, NA_integer_, COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]],
                                           standardize = FALSE,
                                           fixed_time = list(t_max = T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]], q = Q_PAPER))
.d_k13b   <- build_nguyen_design_traintest(.tr, .te, K_VALUES[[DATASET]], COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]],
                                           standardize = FALSE, fixed_time = NULL)
stopifnot(identical(.d_k13[c("X", "X_orig", "yr", "y01", "X_test_cov", "t_s", "scale_unit", "sd_vec", "ctr")],
                    .d_k13b[c("X", "X_orig", "yr", "y01", "X_test_cov", "t_s", "scale_unit", "sd_vec", "ctr")]))

e_k <- 3L
chk <- list(
  `区間数 actual_K: q200 = formal = 200`        = identical(.d_q200$actual_K, .d_formal$actual_K) && .d_q200$actual_K == Q_PAPER,
  `区間代表時刻 t_s: q200 = formal`             = identical(.d_q200$t_s, .d_formal$t_s),
  `展開行数と y_ik: q200 = formal`              = identical(.d_q200$rows, .d_formal$rows) && identical(.d_q200$y01, .d_formal$y01),
  `スプライン列 A(t): q200 = formal`            = identical(.d_q200$X[, seq_len(e_k)], .d_formal$X[, seq_len(e_k)]),
  `中心化ベクトル ctr: q200 = K13`              = identical(.d_q200$ctr, .d_k13$ctr),
  `尺度 scale_unit: q200 = K13`                 = identical(.d_q200$scale_unit, .d_k13$scale_unit),
  `SD 因子 sd_vec: q200 = K13（= 1）`           = identical(.d_q200$sd_vec, .d_k13$sd_vec),
  `test 変換行列 X_test_cov: q200 = K13`        = identical(.d_q200$X_test_cov, .d_k13$X_test_cov),
  `中心化 ctr: q200 ≠ formal`                   = !identical(.d_q200$ctr, .d_formal$ctr),
  `尺度 scale_unit: q200 ≠ formal`              = !identical(.d_q200$scale_unit, .d_formal$scale_unit),
  `区間 actual_K: q200 ≠ K13`                   = !identical(.d_q200$actual_K, .d_k13$actual_K),
  `時間正規化 t_s: q200 ≠ K13`                  = !identical(.d_q200$t_s, .d_k13$t_s)
)
kable(data.frame(照合 = names(chk), 結果 = ifelse(unlist(chk), "✅", "❌"), row.names = NULL),
      caption = "第 3 変種の設計照合（1 分割）。q200 は区間・時間が formal と同一、正規化が K13 と同一である")
stopifnot(all(unlist(chk)))
cat(sprintf("設計照合 OK: q200 の展開行数 %d（formal %d・K13 %d）、scale_unit %.6f（K13 と同一）、d = %d\n",
            .d_q200$rows, .d_formal$rows, .d_k13$rows, .d_q200$scale_unit, .d_q200$d))
rm(.sp, .tr, .te, .d_formal, .d_k13, .d_q200, .d_k13b)
```

```{r design-check-K13}
  `クリップ率: formal_K13 = formal_q200`             = identical(.d_k13f$clip_rate, .d_q200$clip_rate),
  `区間 actual_K: formal_K13 ≠ formal_q200`          = !identical(.d_k13f$actual_K, .d_q200$actual_K),
  `展開行数: formal_K13 < formal_q200`               = .d_k13f$rows < .d_q200$rows
)
kable(data.frame(照合 = names(chk4), 結果 = ifelse(unlist(chk4), "✅", "❌"), row.names = NULL),
      caption = "第 4 変種の設計照合（1 分割）。formal_K13 は formal_q200 と区間数だけが違う")
stopifnot(all(unlist(chk4)))
cat(sprintf("設計照合 OK: formal_K13 の展開行数 %d（formal_q200 %d）、d = %d（formal_q200 %d）\n",
            .d_k13f$rows, .d_q200$rows, .d_k13f$d, .d_q200$d))
rm(.sp, .tr, .te, .d_q200, .d_k13f)
```

```{r smoke}
run_pilot_isolated <- function(B, base_seed, lambda_grid, specs) {
  callr::r(
    function(B, base_seed, lambda_grid, PROJ, Q_PAPER, specs) {
      Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
                 MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1", VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
                 RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS = "1")
      suppressMessages({ library(survival); library(splines); library(dplyr); library(furrr) })
      for (f in c("main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_input_perturbation_phase1.R",
                  "main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_input_perturbation_phase3.R",
            "main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_bounds_comparison.R",
                  "main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/survival_stacking.R",
                  "main/03_simulation/R/data_split.R",
                  "main/03_simulation/R/simulation_engine.R",
                  "main/04_evaluation/R/nguyen2017_outpert.R")) source(file.path(PROJ, f))
      data <- read.csv(file.path(PROJ, "data/01_prepared/flchain_prepared.csv"))
      stopifnot(is.list(specs), length(specs) >= 1L, all(vapply(specs, function(x) is.character(x$name), logical(1))))
      n_workers <- max(1L, as.integer(floor(parallel::detectCores() * 0.7)))
      plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)
      on.exit(plan(sequential), add = TRUE)
      res <- future_map_dfr(seq_len(B), function(i)
        run_nguyen_iteration(data = data, iteration = i, specs = specs,
          cox_formula = COX_FORMULAS$flchain, dataset_name = "flchain",
          epsilon_values = EPSILON_VALUES, lambda_grid = lambda_grid,
          base_seed = base_seed, split_base_seed = SPLIT_BASE_SEED),
        .options = furrr_options(seed = FALSE))
      list(result = res, n_workers = n_workers)
    },
    args = list(B = B, base_seed = base_seed, lambda_grid = lambda_grid,
                PROJ = PROJ, Q_PAPER = Q_PAPER, specs = specs)
  )
}

t_smoke <- system.time(smoke <- run_pilot_isolated(10L, NG_BASE_SEED, LAMBDA_GRID, SPECS))
cat(sprintf("スモーク(B=10): %.1f 秒 / ワーカー %d / 行数 %d\n",
            t_smoke[["elapsed"]], smoke$n_workers, nrow(smoke$result)))
sm <- smoke$result
stopifnot(nrow(sm) == 10L * length(SPECS) * length(LAMBDA_GRID) * length(EPSILON_VALUES))
stopifnot(!anyNA(sm$c_index_test))
stopifnot(identical(unique(sm$spec), SPEC_NAMES))
kable(sm %>% distinct(spec, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        select(spec, formal, d, S, actual_K, stacked_rows, clip_rate),
      digits = 4, caption = "spec 別の設計諸元。clip_rate は固定境界によるクリップ発生率（train）")
```

```{r production}
res_path <- file.path(PROJ, "data/04_evaluation/exp_g_pilot_flchain_raw.csv")
fp_path  <- file.path(PROJ, "data/04_evaluation/exp_g_pilot_flchain_raw.fingerprint")

gen_fingerprint <- digest::digest(list(
  dataset = DATASET,
  bounds  = FIXED_BOUNDS_NGUYEN[[DATASET]],
  t_max   = T_MAX_FIXED_NGUYEN[[DATASET]],
  q       = Q_PAPER,
  K       = K_VALUES[[DATASET]],
  lambda_grid = LAMBDA_GRID,
  epsilon = EPSILON_VALUES,
  B       = B_RUN,
  base_seed  = NG_BASE_SEED,
  split_seed = SPLIT_BASE_SEED,
  cox_formula = deparse(COX_FORMULAS[[DATASET]]),
  specs = SPECS
), algo = "sha256")

if (file.exists(res_path)) {
  raw <- read.csv(res_path)
  if (file.exists(fp_path)) {
    stored <- readLines(fp_path, warn = FALSE)[1]
    if (!identical(stored, gen_fingerprint))
      stop("生データの生成設定が現在の設定と一致しない（指紋不一致）。\n",
           "  保存済み: ", stored, "\n  現在    : ", gen_fingerprint, "\n",
           "  ", res_path, " を削除して再実行するか、設定を戻すこと。")
    cat(sprintf("既存結果を読み込み: %d 行（設定指紋 %s… 一致）\n",
                nrow(raw), substr(gen_fingerprint, 1, 12)))
  } else {
    writeLines(gen_fingerprint, fp_path)
    cat(sprintf("既存結果を読み込み: %d 行。指紋ファイルが無かったため現在の設定で作成した（%s…）\n",
                nrow(raw), substr(gen_fingerprint, 1, 12)))
  }
} else {
  t_prod <- system.time(prod <- run_pilot_isolated(B_RUN, NG_BASE_SEED, LAMBDA_GRID, SPECS))
  raw <- prod$result
  cat(sprintf("本番(B=%d): %.1f 秒 = %.1f 分 / ワーカー %d\n",
              B_RUN, t_prod[["elapsed"]], t_prod[["elapsed"]]/60, prod$n_workers))
  write.csv(raw, res_path, row.names = FALSE)
  writeLines(gen_fingerprint, fp_path)
}

expected_rows <- B_RUN * length(SPECS) * length(LAMBDA_GRID) * length(EPSILON_VALUES)
stopifnot(nrow(raw) == expected_rows, !anyNA(raw$c_index_test), !anyNA(raw$mre))
stopifnot(all(raw$c_index_test > 0 & raw$c_index_test < 1))
stopifnot(length(unique(raw$iteration)) == B_RUN)
cat(sprintf("検算 OK（%d 行 = %d 反復 × %d spec × %d Λ × %d ε）\n",
            expected_rows, B_RUN, length(SPECS), length(LAMBDA_GRID), length(EPSILON_VALUES)))

ref <- raw %>% distinct(iteration, spec, c_index_test_ref) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c_index_test_ref)
stopifnot(identical(sort(setdiff(names(ref), "iteration")), sort(SPEC_NAMES)))
ref_pairs <- data.frame(
  組 = c("formal_q200 − datadriven_K13（4 要素すべて）",
         "datadriven_q200 − datadriven_K13（区間・時間正規化だけ）",
         "datadriven_q200 − formal_q200（正規化だけ）",
         "formal_K13 − formal_q200（区間数だけ）"),
  平均絶対差 = c(mean(abs(ref$formal_q200 - ref$datadriven_K13)),
                 mean(abs(ref$datadriven_q200 - ref$datadriven_K13)),
                 mean(abs(ref$datadriven_q200 - ref$formal_q200)),
                 mean(abs(ref$formal_K13 - ref$formal_q200))),
  最大絶対差 = c(max(abs(ref$formal_q200 - ref$datadriven_K13)),
                 max(abs(ref$datadriven_q200 - ref$datadriven_K13)),
                 max(abs(ref$datadriven_q200 - ref$formal_q200)),
                 max(abs(ref$formal_K13 - ref$formal_q200))),
  row.names = NULL)
kable(ref_pairs, digits = 5, caption = "非私的（正則化なし）test C-index の変種間差（B = 1,000 分割）")
stopifnot(all(ref_pairs$平均絶対差 < 0.02))

kable(raw %>% group_by(spec) %>%
        summarise(CFR = mean(!converged), `非私的 C-index` = mean(c_index_test_ref),
                  `SD` = sd(c_index_test_ref), clip_rate = mean(clip_rate),
                  stacked_rows = first(stacked_rows), .groups = "drop"),
      digits = 5, caption = "収束失敗率・非私的基準値・クリップ率")

cfr_lam <- raw %>% distinct(spec, lambda, iteration, converged, grad_norm) %>%
  group_by(spec, lambda) %>%
  summarise(CFR = mean(!converged), n_fail = sum(!converged), max_grad = max(grad_norm), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(spec, lambda)
kable(cfr_lam, digits = c(0, 4, 5, 0, 8),
      caption = "収束失敗率（spec × Λ）。CFR は 1,000 分割中の非収束の割合、max_grad は相対勾配ノルムの最大")
```

```{r agg}
agg <- raw %>% group_by(spec, formal, lambda, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(c_test = mean(c_index_test), c_test_sd = sd(c_index_test),
            c_test_lambda = mean(c_index_test_lambda),
            mre = mean(mre), beta_ratio = mean(beta_norm_ratio),
            c_test_median = median(c_index_test), c_test_below_half = mean(c_index_test < 0.5),
            .groups = "drop")
ref_c <- mean(raw$c_index_test_ref[raw$spec == "formal_q200"])
```

```{r fixed-vs-oracle}
LAM_FIXED <- 0.1
best <- agg %>% group_by(spec, epsilon) %>%
  slice_max(c_test, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
fixed <- agg %>% filter(abs(lambda - LAM_FIXED) < 1e-9)

cmp <- bind_rows(
  fixed %>% mutate(sel = sprintf("Λ=%g 事前固定", LAM_FIXED)),
  best  %>% mutate(sel = "Λ oracle 選択（参考）")) %>%
  filter(epsilon %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 30, 100, Inf)) %>%
  select(spec, sel, epsilon, c_test) %>% mutate(c_test = round(c_test, 4)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = epsilon, values_from = c_test, names_prefix = "eps=")
kable(cmp, caption = "事前固定 Λ と oracle 選択。差が小さければ oracle に依存していない。oracle は非収束の当てはめを含む（Λ=10・1000 の q=200 変種。主結果 Λ=0.1 は非収束 0）")
```

```{r formal-vs-dd}
kable(fixed %>% filter(epsilon %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 30, Inf)) %>%
        select(spec, epsilon, c_test, c_test_sd) %>%
        mutate(across(c(c_test, c_test_sd), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = epsilon, values_from = c(c_test, c_test_sd)),
      caption = sprintf("Λ = %g 固定（既報 Table 2 の FL 最良値）。formal_q200 が正当な数値、datadriven_K13 / datadriven_q200 は formal ではない参照値", LAM_FIXED))

gap <- fixed %>% select(spec, epsilon, c_test) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c_test) %>%
  mutate(price_norm_only = datadriven_q200 - formal_q200,
         price_K13_old   = datadriven_K13  - formal_q200,
         interval_effect = datadriven_K13  - datadriven_q200,
         interval_count_formal = formal_K13 - formal_q200)
kable(gap %>% filter(epsilon %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 30, Inf)) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))),
      caption = "保証の値段 price_norm_only = datadriven_q200 − formal_q200（現行）。price_K13_old は旧定義、interval_effect は区間の置き方の効果")
cat(sprintf("保証の値段（正規化だけ）: ε=0.5 %.4f / ε=1 %.4f / ε=10 %.4f / ε=∞ %.4f。実用域 ε=1〜10 で %.3f〜%.3f\n",
            gap$price_norm_only[gap$epsilon == 0.5], gap$price_norm_only[gap$epsilon == 1],
            gap$price_norm_only[gap$epsilon == 10], gap$price_norm_only[is.infinite(gap$epsilon)],
            min(gap$price_norm_only[gap$epsilon >= 1 & gap$epsilon <= 10]),
            max(gap$price_norm_only[gap$epsilon >= 1 & gap$epsilon <= 10])))

dist <- fixed %>% select(spec, epsilon, c_test_median, c_test_below_half) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c(c_test_median, c_test_below_half)) %>%
  mutate(median_diff = c_test_median_datadriven_q200 - c_test_median_formal_q200)
kable(dist %>% filter(epsilon %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, Inf)) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))),
      caption = "test C-index の中央値と C < 0.5 の分割の割合（Λ = 0.1）。datadriven_q200 は低 ε で二峰（年齢の係数の符号反転）")
h1 <- raw %>% filter(abs(lambda - LAM_FIXED) < 1e-9, epsilon == 1)
cnt <- function(s, a, b) sum(h1$c_index_test[h1$spec == s] >= a & h1$c_index_test[h1$spec == s] < b)
cat(sprintf("ε=1 の度数: datadriven_q200 は [0.2,0.3) %d / [0.7,0.8) %d / [0.4,0.6) %d、formal_q200 は [0.6,0.7) %d / [0.4,0.6) %d\n",
            cnt("datadriven_q200", 0.2, 0.3), cnt("datadriven_q200", 0.7, 0.8), cnt("datadriven_q200", 0.4, 0.6),
            cnt("formal_q200", 0.6, 0.7), cnt("formal_q200", 0.4, 0.6)))
```

```{r compare-arms}
summ_ctest <- function(x, nm) {
  x %>% distinct(epsilon, iteration, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(epsilon) %>% summarise(c_test = mean(c_index_test, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(arm = nm, formal = FALSE)
}
rf <- file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation/reffix_traintest")
fs_rf <- c(`Phase 1` = "all_phase1_reffix_traintest.parquet", `Phase 2` = "all_phase2_reffix_traintest.parquet",
           `Phase 3` = "all_phase3_reffix_traintest.parquet",
           `Out (std)` = "all_output_std_reffix_traintest.parquet",
           `Out (dfbeta)` = "all_output_dfbeta_reffix_traintest.parquet")
ARM_ORDER <- c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Out (Laplace)", "Out (std)", "Out (dfbeta)")
laplace_csv <- file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation/traintest/flchain_output_traintest.csv")
existing <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fs_rf), function(nm) {
    p <- file.path(rf, fs_rf[[nm]]); stopifnot(file.exists(p))
    arrow::read_parquet(p, col_select = c("dataset", "epsilon", "iteration", "c_index_test")) %>%
      filter(dataset == "flchain") %>% summ_ctest(nm)
  }),
  if (file.exists(laplace_csv)) summ_ctest(read.csv(laplace_csv), "Out (Laplace)")) %>%
  arrange(match(arm, ARM_ORDER), epsilon)

ARM_NAMES_G <- c(formal_q200     = "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, q=200)",
                 formal_K13      = "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, K=13)",
                 datadriven_K13  = "Nguyen Alg.1 (v2, 非 formal)",
                 datadriven_q200 = "Nguyen Alg.1 (data-dependent normalisation only, q=200)")
stopifnot(setequal(names(ARM_NAMES_G), SPEC_NAMES))
SPEC_FORMAL <- setNames(vapply(SPECS, function(sp) identical(sp$type, "formal"), logical(1)),
                        SPEC_NAMES)
stopifnot(sum(SPEC_FORMAL) == 2L,
          setequal(names(which(SPEC_FORMAL)), c("formal_q200", "formal_K13")))
ours <- fixed %>% transmute(epsilon, c_test,
  arm = unname(ARM_NAMES_G[spec]),
  formal = unname(SPEC_FORMAL[spec]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(ours$arm), !anyNA(ours$formal))
comp <- bind_rows(existing, ours)

kable(comp %>% filter(epsilon %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 30, 100, Inf)) %>%
        select(arm, epsilon, c_test) %>% mutate(c_test = round(c_test, 4)) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = epsilon, values_from = c_test, names_prefix = "eps="),
      caption = paste0("flchain・同一の都度分割・B = 1000 でのテスト C-index。formal 保証があるのは ",
                       "Nguyen Alg.1 の完全データ非依存な 2 仕様（formal, q=200 と formal, K=13）である"))
```

```{r formal-k13-table}
mc_se <- function(sd) sd / sqrt(B_RUN)
k13 <- fixed %>% filter(spec %in% c("formal_q200", "formal_K13")) %>%
  select(spec, epsilon, c_test, c_test_sd) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c(c_test, c_test_sd)) %>%
  mutate(se_formal_K13 = mc_se(c_test_sd_formal_K13), se_formal_q200 = mc_se(c_test_sd_formal_q200),
         diff_K13_minus_q200 = c_test_formal_K13 - c_test_formal_q200,
         ref_c_formal_K13  = mean(raw$c_index_test_ref[raw$spec == "formal_K13"]),
         ref_c_formal_q200 = mean(raw$c_index_test_ref[raw$spec == "formal_q200"]),
         gap_K13 = ref_c_formal_K13 - c_test_formal_K13) %>%
  arrange(epsilon) %>%
  select(epsilon, c_test_formal_K13, se_formal_K13, c_test_formal_q200, se_formal_q200,
         diff_K13_minus_q200, gap_K13, ref_c_formal_K13, ref_c_formal_q200)
stopifnot(nrow(k13) == length(EPSILON_VALUES), !anyNA(k13))
kable(k13 %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !epsilon, ~ round(.x, 4))),
      caption = "formal_K13（Λ = 0.1）: test C-index の平均と MC 標準誤差、formal_q200 との差、非私的参照値（K = 13 等幅・正則化なし）")
write.csv(k13 %>% mutate(epsilon = ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), "Inf", as.character(epsilon))),
          file.path(PROJ, "data/04_evaluation/exp_g_formal_K13.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("formal_K13: ε=1 %.4f（formal_q200 %.4f、差 %+.4f）、ε=∞ %.4f、非私的 %.4f\n",
            k13$c_test_formal_K13[k13$epsilon == 1], k13$c_test_formal_q200[k13$epsilon == 1],
            k13$diff_K13_minus_q200[k13$epsilon == 1], k13$c_test_formal_K13[is.infinite(k13$epsilon)],
            k13$ref_c_formal_K13[1]))
```
